text:
mira_pm: Looping folks on a new packaging idea: "LaneReserve" — a tiny addon that reserves per-route throughput and gives a simple 99p latency promise. Need quick alignment on packaging bands, pilot terms, and must-have launch checks.

ben_eng: Tech: minimal viable approach is banded reservations (fixed RPS buckets) and a proxy-level tag to route to reserved workers. Enforcement via token buckets per route. Fast pilot = no full autoscaler integration.

tara_sre: Ops concerns: noisy neighbor isolation and a clear exhaustion policy. Propose: when reserved pool exhausted -> queue up to Xms, then fallback to best-effort plus alerting. Need a non-ops escalation path for customer-facing incidents.

aldo_sales: Sales feedback: field wants a single line item SKU and simple bands (e.g., Lane-50, Lane-250, Lane-1000). They don't want per-token math. Also need a usage dashboard to show utilization so customers can justify cost internally.

pat_fin: Bands are easier to forecast. Ask product for projected utilization assumptions; I'll run margin sims. Suggest 30-45% margin target over marginal infra.

zoe_legal: Contracts: define "reserved" (soft vs hard), exclusions, and a capped credit table. For pilots, use a short addendum to limit liability and allow GA terms to change. Also require disclosure if fallback routes to lower-tier models.

mira_pm: Draft launch gating: 1) 2 pilot customers on bands, 2) console shows per-lane metrics, 3) staging validates 99p under 1.5x load, 4) billing line item and invoice display, 5) legal pilot addendum approved.

ben_eng: Engineering checklist: API: POST /lane/reserve {route, band, start, duration}; proxy honors lane tag; metrics: lane_reserved, lane_consumed, lane_downgraded; test: chaos when reserved pool loses 25% capacity. Estimate MVP pilot in ~8-10 weeks if prioritized.

tara_sre: I'll build a synthetic harness to exercise exhaustion and measure tail latencies. Also want alert if reserved utilization stays <30% for >14 days (to flag wasted spend).

aldo_sales: Pilot incentives: 40% off month 1 + one SE migration day. Keep pilot term <= 3 months to avoid long tail renegotiations.

pat_fin: I'll prepare P&L scenarios for bands vs $/rps by EOW. If utilization is low we'll need a lower-entry band or usage credit model.

zoe_legal: I'll draft pilot addendum and the SLA bullets. We'll need clear definitions for "normal operation" and a max monthly credit cap.

ci-bot: ci-bot: pushed lane-proxy branch to staging at 2025-04-15T09:12Z, smoke tests green.

mira_pm: Great. Actions: Ben = engineering epic + timeline, Pat = P&L bands, Zoe = legal pilot addendum, Aldo = pilot shortlist, Tara = staging test harness. Follow-up Thurs 11am PT. If anyone disagrees with gating DM me. :thumbsup:
